title: Man City found guilty of majority of 115 financial rule breaches
description: The club, which denies all wrongdoing, is accused of breaching the Premier League's financial rules between 2009 and 2018.

title: Watch: What could the potential sanctions for Man City be?
description: Football finance expert Kieran Maguire says the potential sanctions for Manchester City will be 'significant' after the sources told BBC Sport that the club has been found guilty of breaking the majority of the 115 financial rules they were accused of breaching.

title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
description: Asked about the Iranian offer, a US official said discussions were taking place through mediators.

title: I'm not tempted to call an early election, Burnham says
description: The prime minister told the BBC an early poll would throw the country into a "backward-looking process".

title: OpenAI investigating 'dozens' of instances of agents acting improperly
description: OpenAI agents tried to get information from "governments, universities, public agencies, and other institutions" through extreme means that sometimes curbed security controls, the company said.

title: Trump's plans for massive arch move ahead
description: Opposition to building the 250-foot arch, and using it for military purposes, is growing with one Democrat blasting Trump's plans as "foolhardy".

title: U2 celebrate 50th anniversary at the school where they formed
description: The rock band go back to their roots, playing a gig in the Dublin playground where they first met.

title: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says
description: Such strikes aim to disrupt "people's ability to stay connected, study, work", says Ukraine's president.

title: Black woman found hanging from tree was dead before body was 'staged' - US media
description: Tasia Fortune's body was found hanging from a tree on the grounds of an abandoned home in Jackson in August.
